\cvsection{Research interests}
I work on learning and planning for robot manipulation and whole-body control. My current research explores action abstractions from human motion capture for planning with learned world models, and Q-guided recovery for frozen imitation policies, toward reliable humanoid loco-manipulation.

\cvsection{Research experience}
\cventry{Rutgers University}{Jan 2023 -- present}{Graduate Student Researcher · New Brunswick, NJ}{Conducted research in robot learning for 3D scene understanding, object rearrangement, and placement.\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=13pt,itemsep=2pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=3pt]\item \href{https://ovsg-l.github.io/}{\underline{OVSG}} (CoRL 2023): Built the evaluation pipeline and \href{https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.24307072.v1}{\underline{DOVE-G}} benchmark (8 scenarios, 4,000 queries) for context-aware entity grounding; reconstructed 3D scenes and integrated the \href{https://concept-fusion.github.io/}{\underline{ConceptFusion}} baseline.
\item \href{https://lgmcts.github.io/}{\underline{LGMCTS}} (IROS 2024): Co-developed the language-guided rearrangement benchmark with multi-pattern goals and initially infeasible scenes; developed the object-selection network, language parser, and evaluation pipeline.
\item \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.00499}{\underline{DAP}} (IROS 2024): Collected data and evaluated a diffusion-based affordance prediction framework for multi-modal object storage that combines placeable-region sampling with point-cloud correspondences to estimate 6D placement poses.\end{itemize}}
